info.title: GitHappens Cloud API
info.description:
GitHappens Cloud REST contract (spec 14 §5.3). Single source of truth for services/cloud and the
desktop CloudClient. All bodies are JSON unless noted; all `/v1/*` routes except the ones marked
PUBLIC require `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`.

Conventions
- Errors: non-2xx with `ApiError` body. 401 `unauthorized` (expired/invalid access token → refresh
  and retry once), 403 `forbidden`, 404 `not_found`, 409 `conflict`, 410 `gone` (expired/deleted
  patch), 412 `precondition_failed` (If-Match version mismatch; body carries `currentVersion`),
  413 `too_large`, 422 `validation`, 429 `rate_limited` (+ `Retry-After` seconds).
- Optimistic concurrency: resources with `version` accept `If-Match: <version>` on writes; the server
  increments `version` on every successful write. Creating a sync category uses `If-Match: 0`.
- Pagination: list routes accept `?cursor=&limit=` (default 50, max 200) and return `Page<T>`.
- Times are ISO-8601 strings (UTC). Ids are UUIDs except patch ids (22-char base62, 128-bit random).
- Binary payloads (sync ciphertext, nonces) are base64url strings without padding.

PUBLIC HTML viewer page; decrypts in the browser using the `#k=` fragment (fragment never reaches the server) and offers "Open in GitHappens" (githappens://patch/<id>#k=<key>).

→ Me

→ OrgDetail (members only)

post.summary: SuggestionCreate → 201 Suggestion (patch must be the caller's, kind 'suggestion', completed and live)

→ Suggestion — Bearer OPTIONAL (same rule as the patch)

doc.description: Workspace document WITHOUT local paths (spec 11 Workspace minus localPath fields).

CloudWorkspaceDoc.description: Cloud workspace document written by the desktop (`CloudWorkspace.doc`); never contains local paths.

path.description: Only when org policy footprintSharePaths = true.

ranges.description: Changed line ranges in BASE-file coordinates, inclusive [start, end]; empty = whole file / unknown.

IdpId.description: `dev` exists only when the server runs with GH_CLOUD_DEV_LOGIN=1 (tests / local development).

footprintSalt.description: Per-org secret for footprint path HMACs (members only; spec 14 §6.5). base64url, 32 bytes.
Per-org secret for footprint path HMACs (members only; spec 14 §6.5). base64url, 32 bytes.

patchMaxExpiryDays.description: Max patch expiry in days; null = no cap.

footprintSharePaths.description: Footprints carry plaintext paths (default false → path hashes only).

footprintShareBranchNames.description: Footprints carry a plaintext branch label (default false → hash only).

initialCommitSha.description: First root commit (`git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD | tail -1`) — matches forks/mirrors.

idps.description: Identity providers configured on this server.

webUrl.description: Web viewer of the underlying patch (`<server>/p/<patchId>`; the desktop appends `#k=` for e2e).

prHeadSha.description: PR head the suggestion was made against (40/64 hex).

commentId.description: Provider comment id once the PR comment exists (can be set later with PATCH).

coAuthor.description: Identity for the `Co-authored-by:` trailer when the author commits the suggestion.

SyncCategory.description: Desktop categories plus `_keys` (wrapped data-encryption key). Server accepts /^[a-z_][a-z0-9-]{0,40}$/.
